limits: Sources continued to append during measurement; paths, bodies, session identifiers and titles are excluded.
Three trials, same process, warm cache after first read; CPU frequency, garbage collection and other desktop work were uncontrolled.

Prototype native newline splitter is not production-ready: inline-image discard and associated validation behavior were not preserved and semantic event hashes were not compared. Row/event-kind counts match only.
Timing counters are nested: batchEvents includes scanning, JSON.parse, adapter logic and SQLite insertion; do not sum nested counters.
Main measurements completed successfully; the original report's final row-count query used incorrect table names and was corrected afterward. This report preserves measured stdout values, no rerun.
The second real-source refresh was not unchanged: six files changed while the chat and subagents were active.
